steps.message: What was the longest distance covered in a swimming activity in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single number in meters rounded to the nearest integer.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i opentracks; cmd package help | sed -n '1,220p'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -i opentracks; cmd package help | sed -n '1,220p'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "cmd package help | grep -in 'content\|provider'; dumpsys activity providers | grep -i -A2 -B2 'de.dennisguse.opentracks'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "cmd package help | grep -in 'content\|provider'; dumpsys activity providers | grep -i -A2 -B2 'de.dennisguse.opentracks'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "for d in /sdcard/Android/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks; do echo '##' $d; ls -la $d 2>/dev/null; ls -la $d/files 2>/dev/null; find $d -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.gpx' -o -iname '*.tcx' -o -iname '*.csv' -o -iname '*.db' -o -iname '*.sqlite*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 50; done"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "for d in /sdcard/Android/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/de.dennisguse.opentracks; do echo '##' $d; ls -la $d 2>/dev/null; ls -la $d/files 2>/dev/null; find $d -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.gpx' -o -iname '*.tcx' -o -iname '*.csv' -o -iname '*.db' -o -iname '*.sqlite*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 50; done""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "for a in de.dennisguse.opentracks de.dennisguse.opentracks.data de.dennisguse.opentracks.provider de.dennisguse.opentracks.content de.dennisguse.opentracks.services.contentprovider; do for p in tracks track trackpoints activities activity segments statistics; do u=content://$a/$p; echo '##' $u; content query --uri $u 2>&1 | sed -n '1,6p'; done; done"
